proof_body:
by
  intro a r s hr hrec
  have hne : 1 - r ≠ 0 := by
    have := (abs_lt.mp hr).2
    linarith
  set L := s / (1 - r) with hL
  have hfix : L = r * L + s := by
    rw [hL]
    field_simp
    ring
  have hclosed : ∀ n, a n = r ^ n * (a 0 - L) + L := by
    intro n
    induction n with
    | zero => simp
    | succ m ih =>
      rw [hrec, ih, pow_succ]
      linarith [hfix, mul_comm (r ^ m) r]
  have hlim := ((tendsto_pow_atTop_nhds_zero_of_abs_lt_one hr).mul_const (a 0 - L)).add_const L
  simp only [zero_mul, zero_add] at hlim
  exact hlim.congr fun n => (hclosed n).symm
target_source: ∀ (a : ℕ → ℝ) (r s : ℝ), |r| < 1 → (∀ n, a (n + 1) = r * a n + s) → Filter.Tendsto a Filter.atTop (nhds (s / (1 - r)))
